evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco thermodynamic relation extend to higher-dimensional Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton black holes throughout the event/cosmological-horizon coexistence region, and to rotating cylindrical or toroidal black branes when several thermodynamic variables respond to a cosmological perturbation?

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on rotating charged black strings with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does the Goon-Penco energy-entropy relation extend to rotating charged black strings with cylindrical horizons, particularly when angular momentum, charge and other thermodynamic state variables depend on the cosmological-constant perturbation η?

sources.title: Universal thermodynamic extremality relations for charged AdS black hole surrounded by quintessence

evidence.text: Compare corrected and uncorrected near-extremal mass and entropy numerically, varying electric charge, deformation ε and AdS radius l. These comparisons supply the paper's evidence for the direction of entropy and mass shifts.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture of charged-rotating-AdS black hole surrounded by quintessence and string cloud

evidence.text: The authors replace the cosmological term 2Λ by 2(1+ε)Λ, write modified mass and temperature expressions, invert the mass relation for ε, and differentiate with respect to entropy and other thermodynamic parameters. Extremality is imposed through T=0.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture, black branes and violations of universal thermodynamics relation

evidence.text: For each model, replace the cosmological term −2Λ by −2(1+ε)Λ, then present corrected mass and temperature as functions of entropy and model parameters. The displayed deformation changes the cosmological term rather than introducing an explicit higher-derivative operator.

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation of accelerating black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Solve f(r_+)=0 for the shifted mass parameter, use S=πr_+^2/[K(1−A^2r_+^2)], invert the entropy–radius relation and express the mass parameter and normalized Hawking temperature in terms of entropy and ε.

sources.title: Thermodynamic extremality in Power-law AdS black holes: a universal perspective

evidence.text: Review the Gibbs-free-energy argument using S=−∂G/∂T and Qi=−∂G/∂μi, Legendre transformation and chain-rule differentiation, followed by the T→0 limit under an entropy regularity assumption.

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on black branes with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: For rotating branes, regard S, J and Q as a complete extensive set and define T, Ωi and U through mass derivatives. Apply the chain rule to the explicit η dependence and state-variable responses, using dM=T+dS+ΣiΩidJi+UdQ, then select different quantities to hold invariant.

sources.title: Universal thermodynamic relations with constant corrections for rotating AdS black holes

evidence.text: Does the previously proposed entropy–extremality relation hold for rotating BTZ and Kerr-AdS black holes under a constant action correction, and is there an analogous relation involving the shift of angular momentum?

sources.title: Thermodynamic relation on higher-dimensional black hole with arbitrary cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation retain its form for higher-dimensional charged Reissner–Nordström black holes with positive or negative cosmological constant, including extremal and Nariai limits?

sources.title: Thermodynamic extremality relations in massive gravity

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality relation extend to charged topological black holes in higher-dimensional massive gravity, and are there corresponding relations involving pressure, charge and massive-potential parameters?

sources.title: Stability of Extremal Black Holes and Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Kiselev Spacetime

evidence.text: How do small cosmological-constant-related perturbations affect extremal black-hole thermodynamics and WGC-based stability, and does charged-scalar scattering preserve entropy increase and weak cosmic censorship in quantum-corrected RN-AdS Kiselev spacetime?

sources.title: Universality on thermodynamic relation with corrections in de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality response relation hold for de Sitter black holes under a small cosmological-term correction, particularly at the outer–cosmological horizon merger, and what does this suggest about the WGC?

sources.title: Universality on the thermodynamic relation with corrections in higher-dimensional de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality response relation extend to higher-dimensional de Sitter black holes, to approaches along either horizon toward both mass endpoints, and to ensembles allowing charge and angular momentum to shift with the perturbation?

evidence.text: Does a small constant deformation of the cosmological term reproduce entropy–extremality relations across selected AdS black holes, extend them to other thermodynamic conjugates, and support a WGC-like interpretation of corrected mass-to-charge behavior?

sources.title: No Existence of Black Holes at LHC Due to Minimal Length in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Solve the resulting quadratic inequalities for momentum uncertainty, estimate temperature, and use the first law dS=Mp c² dm/T and C=Mp c² dm/dT for thermodynamics. Estimate mass loss with a Stefan–Boltzmann law dominated by four-dimensional brane emission.

sources.title: No Existence of Black Holes at LHC Due to Minimal Length in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Use the photon-gas relation c⟨p⟩=2.821 TH together with the Hawking–uncertainty identification to set μ=[2.821(D−3)/π]², ⟨p⟩=√μ Δp and ⟨p²⟩=(1+μ)Δp². Substitute these moment relations into the GUP inequalities.

sources.title: No Existence of Black Holes at LHC Due to Minimal Length in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Model the position uncertainty of an emitted particle as Δx≈2rs and identify cΔp with its characteristic energy. Multiply the uncertainty-based estimate by the calibration factor (D−3)/π to reproduce the standard D-dimensional Hawking temperature before applying GUP modifications.
